scope: Reusable DMA-only bank subsystem generation template and generic ownership/router/memory children. Existing fixed bank_subsystem/execution_fabric and model RTL unchanged.
authorization: User approved structural refactor and steered shared implementation to MM2S/S2MM only; compute role interfaces generated per design by Agents.
common_contract_boundary: Opt-in native per-direction ownership. Existing common/local_bank_contract.json v2 remains exclusive; bank_subsystem_legacy preserves that interface. Existing model revisions are not migrated.
package: Generated bank config package owns bank counts/types/widths/depths/capability masks and role IDs; reusable children parameterized. Default DMA-only test config: 2 active banks, BRAM128/128 depth64 and URAM128/128 depth4096; memory latency3 + request register1 = total4. Configuration is illustrative, not target model.
ports: Template public named ports ONLY native MM2S/S2MM role arrays plus explicit acquire/release wr/rd valid/port and state/error/commit. USER_*_BEGIN/END extension markers for generated compute role ports/config/internal routing. Generic router internal interface per-bank requests with owner tags, addr/data/strb and responses valid/data/owner tags. No compute role name or ID in shared implementation.
ownership: Cross-direction acquire vectors atomic: any illegal capability/conflict or acquire-release overlap rejects all requested acquires. Cross-direction release vectors atomic: reject free/mismatched/overlap and reader pending. Sticky first ownership/router/subsystem errors; legal transactions continue after errors. Data at release edge uses old owner. Reader release blocked when read pending or accepted on same edge; request must be retried. Reset synchronous low.
router: Unsupported/free/non-owner and out-of-range accesses produce sticky error and no memory access. Owner captured for read responses, not current owner. No response backpressure, II=1. Read ena/addr registered one cycle; per-role valid delayed four stages. Physical same-cycle BRAM collision read_first; native simultaneous request write and read are separated by address pipeline, so later memory read observes prior write. URAM same-address collision is vendor-defined and not promised.
commit: Per-bank exclusive committed prefix in read words, ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits. Reset on accepted write acquire; advances only on full-strobe next sequential write address from zero; gaps and partial strobes do not advance. Reads are not gated by prefix. No residual snapshot policy in this scope.
compatibility: Old fixed bank_subsystem.sv and execution_fabric are retained as verified legacy examples without mutation or inheriting evidence. No existing model revision migration. New native template is opt-in; split ownership is scoped to native_v2, not common/local_bank_contract.json v2.
validation: DMA-only generated instance XPM self-checking payload/concurrent wr+rd/latency4/II1
one generated custom compute-role extension proving no fixed compute naming in base
Vivado OOC source-identified synthesis 200MHz; no route/board claims
excluded: existing model migration and old interface adapter
model-specific compute ports in shared IP
